label: Flat Front, Single Dart
description: A flat front with a single dart adds one short, stitched-down dart on each side of the front to shape the waist into the hip without an open pleat. It keeps the smooth flat-front look while improving the fit over a curved seat and thigh. The dart removes excess cloth cleanly rather than letting it fold.
